screens.name: Services & migration
screens.text:
Services & migration

A clear path from local deployment to your cloud environment.

Refresh
Local storage and the search index are separate. Back up the stored originals, database, and encryption key before moving environments. A search index can be rebuilt; a lost original or encryption key cannot.
Local deployment
available

Next.js frontend, Python API, durable local volumes, and configurable vector search.

OpenAI models
setup required

Bring your own API key. Content is sent only with explicit external processing approval.

OCI migration
unverified

Storage, model, and managed vector adapters are implemented. Live tenancy validation is still required before production use.

Migration checklist

Validate each layer before changing the active provider.

1
Create a verified backup

Stop writes and back up the persistent data volume, originals, database, and encryption key. Test a restore in a separate environment.

2
Provision the destination

Confirm OCI region, compartment permissions, Object Storage, model availability, and the supported vector-search service.

3
Validate the cloud adapters

Verify authentication, storage reads and writes, retries, timeouts, vector dimensions, and model limits. Adapter tests do not substitute for a live tenancy round-trip.

4
Copy originals and metadata

Keep document identifiers stable and compare object checksums. Never delete local originals before validating the destination.

5
Rebuild and compare indexes

Reindex when the embedding provider, model, dimensions, or chunk strategy changes. Run known queries and inspect their evidence.

6
Switch with a rollback plan

Run a canary workload, compare answers and extraction results, then switch providers. Retain the tested backup and prior configuration.

Operational boundaries
Storage-first ingestion

A failed embedding or indexing job leaves the original stored. Retry from Jobs & activity after fixing the provider.

Independent cloud billing

OpenAI API and OCI service charges are billed by those providers. A ChatGPT plan does not include this application’s API usage.

No silent provider fallbacks

Unavailable model and cloud adapters report a clear error. Mock mode must be selected explicitly for development tests.

Backups and restore

Use the repository deployment guide and backup scripts. Configuration export is sanitized and is not a complete data backup.
